# Scroll Area A box with a styled scrollbar. ## Usage ```gx

Long content.

 ``` ## Do - Set a height on the area. - Keep the scroll on one axis. ## Don't - Do not nest two scroll areas. - Do not use a scroll area for the whole page. ## Keyboard The area scrolls with the page keys when it holds focus, as the browser defines.
